method: HEAD requests from the user Windows computer using Python urllib; public official endpoints only, no authentication or configuration changes
fallback: Only a nonzero curl HTTP/transfer result triggers archive fallback; a checksum mismatch fails without fallback
limits: HEAD availability and matching size do not prove content identity or actual CI download speed. Every CDN/archive/cache result must pass the original fixed SHA512 check. No Kafka response body was downloaded and no CI run was triggered.
